text: BAM share rose 0.33 percentage points over 25 hours and 1.28 percentage points over 7 days to 35.8%. Concentration remains elevated: the single largest node holds 24.3% of BAM stake, and the node Nakamoto coefficient is 3. Recent precursor signals flag new tyo-mainnet-bam-dev-tee, while leadership changes should still be read as whale-driven routing unless a validated regional cutover appears.
